content_units: Crowd-Pleasing Movie Night Picks

Here are 8 strong choices that fit your group brief: witty, broadly age-friendly, no horror, under 125 minutes, post-2000, and likely to land well if you enjoyed  Knives Out ,  Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse ,  The Martian , and  Paddington 2 .
8 Films That Match Your Taste
Film   Year   Runtime   Mood   Why it fits
Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery     2022   139 min   Playful mystery   It has the same clever ensemble-whodunit energy you liked in  Knives Out , though it slightly misses your runtime target.
The Grand Budapest Hotel     2014   100 min   Whimsical   Fast, funny, visually inventive, and witty without leaning crude.
Fantastic Mr. Fox     2009   87 min   Clever cozy   A smart, all-ages caper with dry humor and nonstop charm.
Hunt for the Wilderpeople     2016   101 min   Warm adventure   It mixes deadpan comedy, heart, and adventure in a way that works across generations.
The Mitchells vs. the Machines     2021   114 min   Chaotic fun   A hilarious, inventive family adventure with big visual energy that should click if you liked  Into the Spider-Verse .
School of Rock     2003   109 min   Feel-good   Big laughs, huge likability, and crowd-pleasing energy without mean-spirited comedy.
Enola Holmes     2020   123 min   Light mystery   A brisk, charming mystery with humor and momentum that feels accessible for mixed ages.
Galaxy Quest     1999   102 min   Nerdy fun   Just outside your release window, but it’s one of the safest, funniest ensemble adventure-comedies for a mixed group.
Best-Fit Shortlist
Option 1:   The Mitchells vs. the Machines     Most likely to please everyone at once; funny, fast, inventive     Best all-around pick
Option 2:   Hunt for the Wilderpeople     Warm, offbeat, and funny with real heart     Best if you want live-action
Option 3:   Fantastic Mr. Fox     Stylish, smart, and easy for all ages to enjoy     Best shorter pick
Option 4:   Enola Holmes     Mystery-forward and friendly for a broad group     Best if you want a puzzle vibe
Small Context Note

Two near-matches are especially worth flagging:  Glass Onion  is excellent for your taste but runs   over 125 minutes  , and  Galaxy Quest  is a near-perfect vibe match but was released   before 2000  .
